name: whatsapp-mcp
description: WhatsApp for your AI agents: an MCP server on Cloudflare Workers, one Durable Object per account.

scripts.check: wrangler types --check && oxlint && oxfmt --check && bun test

SECRET.description: The password of your server. You type it to open the pairing page and to let an AI app connect, and scripts can send it as a Bearer token. At least 16 characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` or your password manager.

AUTH_MODE.description: How MCP clients get in: `oauth` (sign in with the secret in the browser, works in Claude and ChatGPT), `api_key` (send the secret as a Bearer token) or `both`.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA time zone the tools show and read dates in, e.g. `America/Sao_Paulo`.
